verdict.rationale: Paychex Flex has a documented REST API developer portal, but nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec, and probes of the common OpenAPI/Swagger paths all returned 404. A public REST API makes this a fair question for the product, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
